rows.title: Judgement: 'isn't this too simple?' — the sequencing logic in ≤4 sentences
rows.question: Isn't this plan too simple? Content, then email, then paid — feels like something anyone could have written.
rows.reply:
The simplicity is the point — it's sequencing, not a lack of ideas. Writing and email are your named strengths, and NZ$120/day is a testing budget, not one that supports running three channels well at once.

The evidence backs it too: email is already 22% of revenue and rising, repeat purchase is flat at 14%, and paid is gated because Meta and Google Ads are both off. Running content, email, and paid simultaneously on 8 hours a week would just spread you thin across all three instead of proving one.

Your call — I'd stay the course on content now and only flip to phase 2 when a number moves, not because it looks more sophisticated on paper.
